blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The International Criminal Court (ICC) prosecution is planning to fly in and present five witnesses in the trial of former President Rodrigo Duterte before the court for 2026. ICC Prosecutor and Senior Trial Lawyer Julian Nicholls at the fourth status conference in the ICC case of Duterte on Tuesday told trial judges […]...
